questions.question: What are the travel dates?
questions.have: Venetian schedule reviewed for Nov 16 to Dec 9, 2026; Wynn WPT reviewed for Nov 27 to Dec 21.
questions.how: Provide dates. Schedule and hotel columns are filtered to them.

questions.question: What is the total budget (tournaments and lodging)?
questions.have: Official buy-ins and guarantees for the single-entry Venetian events listed on the site.
questions.missing: Budget ceiling, and how much you want to spend per tournament day.

questions.question: Which hotel rates apply to your dates?
questions.have: Official resort fees for the Venetian/Palazzo and Wynn ($55 plus tax). Venetian poker suite rates 'as low as $119 and $209' with play conditions.
questions.missing: Live nightly rates for your dates at each hotel.
questions.how: Check each booking engine on your dates. Add a date-based rate source (see Suggestions).

questions.question: What are the official resort fees for Caesars Palace, Bellagio, ARIA and Horseshoe?
questions.have: Third-party values only, and they conflict.
questions.how: Read the hotel terms on each operator's site, or call the front desk.

questions.question: Do Wynn daily tournaments run during the WPT World Championship?
questions.have: Daily terms say dailies may be suspended during other tournament series.
questions.missing: Confirmed Nov 27 to Dec 21 daily schedule.
questions.how: Call (702) 770-7654 (listed on the Wynn WPT schedule).

questions.question: Are Venetian Events 7, 19 and 26 single-entry or multi-flight?
questions.have: Event 7 structure sheet implies Day 2 chip bags can exclude later flights. Other flight events not opened.
questions.missing: Whether one player can enter multiple flights.
questions.how: Ask the Venetian poker room directly. Contact details are on the official Venetian poker page (venetianlasvegas.com/resort/casino/poker.html).

questions.question: What does the Bellagio Saturday event actually cost?
questions.have: Saturday terms PDF gives conflicting buy-in figures ($1,100 heading; $600 in the body).
questions.missing: Single confirmed buy-in and current dates.
questions.how: Call the Bellagio poker room at 702.693.7291 (number on the official Bellagio poker page).

questions.question: Which Strip rooms run daily tournaments right now?
questions.have: Official data for Caesars, Wynn, Venetian, and Bellagio (weekly). ARIA and Horseshoe have no official schedule.
questions.missing: Official schedules for ARIA and Horseshoe.
questions.how: Call each room. Ask whether daily events run on your dates.

questions.question: Is Planet Hollywood's poker room closed?
questions.have: Trade press (Jan 2026) says closed. A WSOP page says otherwise.
questions.how: Check caesars.com or call the property.

questions.question: Can walking times from each hotel to each room be verified?
questions.have: Addresses for hotels are not on official static pages in this review.
questions.how: Check the routes yourself (links on the schedule page). A map API key would allow this to be automated.

questions.question: Does the Venetian poker-suite rate cover the nights you play?
questions.have: Official rule: 6 hours of live cash play or a buy-in to a $300+ tournament each night for the Venetian poker-suite rate.
questions.missing: Which of your planned days include a $300+ buy-in.
questions.how: Compare the single-entry table's $300+ rows with your planned days.

questions.question: What is the true all-in cost per night at each hotel?
questions.have: Only the resort fees for two hotels.
questions.missing: Nightly rate, resort fee and room tax for your dates.
questions.how: Requires Q03 and Q04. Formula: (nightly rate + resort fee) x (1 + 13.38%) if the room tax applies.
